title: Spectrascape — Paint-to-Sound Studio
description: Draw on a spectrogram and hear it: additive resynthesis with five brushes, scale snapping, WAV + PNG export and shareable links.
concept: A spectrogram you paint instead of read. The canvas is 192 time columns by 88 log-spaced frequency bands, and every lit band becomes one sine oscillator whose amplitude envelope is read straight off the pixels — so what you see is literally what you hear. Five brushes (pure tone, harmonic stack, noise band, decaying pluck, eraser) draw into the grid, an optional scale snap pulls strokes onto chromatic, major, minor, pentatonic or whole-tone pitches, and six presets seed the canvas with chords, birdsong, pads, bells and risers. Finished pieces leave as a 16-bit WAV, a 1920x880 PNG of the spectrogram, or a share link that carries the whole drawing in the URL hash.
features: Five brushes — pure tone ridge, harmonic stack (2-9 partials), noise band, decaying pluck tail, eraser
Additive resynthesis engine: one sine per lit frequency band, amplitude read per-sample from the grid
Scale snapping across chromatic, major, natural minor, pentatonic and whole-tone, with live note/Hz readout
Six seeded presets, three spectral palettes, 18-step undo/redo, and live re-render while the loop plays
Export a 16-bit mono WAV, export the spectrogram as a PNG, or copy a share link holding the whole canvas
localStorage autosave of canvas, length, palette and tuning; share state travels in the URL hash

interaction.mouse: Drag across the canvas to paint sound; the ring shows brush width and the readout names the pitch under the cursor.
interaction.click: Play loops the canvas left to right; brush, preset, palette and export buttons act immediately.
interaction.touch: Single-finger drag paints with touch-action disabled; the toolbar reflows under the canvas on narrow screens.
interaction.keyboard: 1-5 pick a brush, space plays/stops, [ and ] resize the brush, ctrl/cmd+Z undoes and shift+ctrl/cmd+Z redoes.
